title: KPOP Tube Apps Account and Data Deletion
description: How to delete a KPOP Tube app account and associated data.
html:
KPOP Tube Apps

Account and data deletion

계정 및 데이터 삭제 안내

Delete in the app / 앱에서 삭제

  1. Open Profile / 프로필 탭을 엽니다.
  2. Tap Edit profile / 프로필 편집을 누릅니다.
  3. Tap Delete account and confirm / 계정 삭제를 누르고 확인합니다.

Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone. 삭제는 즉시 처리되며 복구할 수 없습니다.

Request by email / 이메일 요청

If the app is unavailable, email the deletion request ID shown under Profile → App info. 앱을 사용할 수 없다면 프로필 → 앱 정보에 표시되는 삭제 요청 ID를 이메일로 보내 주세요.

public.bluemiv@gmail.com

Subject: [KPOP Tube] Account deletion request

Include: app name and deletion request ID / 앱 이름과 삭제 요청 ID

Verified requests are processed within 7 days. 확인 가능한 요청은 7일 이내 처리합니다.

Data deleted / 삭제되는 데이터

  • Pseudonymous profile and public profile fields / 익명 프로필 및 공개 프로필 정보
  • Posts, comments, likes, and attachment references / 글, 댓글, 좋아요, 첨부 참조
  • Gem balance and ad reward records / 젬 잔액 및 광고 보상 기록

On-device favorites are separate from the server account. Clear app data or uninstall the app to remove them. 기기 내 즐겨찾기는 서버 계정과 별도이며 앱 데이터 삭제 또는 앱 제거로 삭제됩니다.

Privacy Policy

title: KPOP Tube Apps 개인정보 처리방침
description: KPOP Tube 앱 제품군의 개인정보 처리방침입니다.
html:
KPOP Tube Apps

개인정보 처리방침

아티스트별 Stan 앱을 포함한 KPOP Tube 앱 제품군이 처리하는 데이터와 이용자 권리를 설명합니다.

시행일: 2026-07-25English
회원가입은 필요하지 않습니다. 앱은 임의의 기기 UUID로 익명 프로필을 만들며, 이름·전화번호·이메일을 가입 정보로 요구하지 않습니다.

1. 처리하는 데이터

  • 익명 프로필: 임의 기기 UUID, 선택한 공개 아이디, 닉네임, 아바타, 앱 그룹, 시스템 언어, 젬 잔액, 계정 상태, 생성·수정 시각
  • 커뮤니티 활동: 글과 댓글 본문, 공개 사진·YouTube 영상 참조, 좋아요, 신고 사유, 익명 작성자 식별값, 작성·신고 시각
  • 광고 보상 기록: 중복 지급 방지를 위한 AdMob 거래 ID, 익명 사용자 ID, 지급량, 지급 시각
  • 기기 내 정보: 사진·영상 즐겨찾기, 언어 설정, 사용자/API 캐시와 보안 세션. 이 정보는 계정 서버 데이터와 별도로 기기에 저장됩니다.
  • 서비스 운영 정보: Cloudflare가 보안, 전송, 속도 제한 및 장애 분석을 위해 IP 주소와 요청 메타데이터를 일시 처리할 수 있습니다.

앱은 연락처, 정밀 위치, 기기 사진·동영상 원본, 결제 카드 정보를 자체 서버로 수집하지 않습니다.

2. 처리 목적

  • 영상·플레이리스트·갤러리·커뮤니티 제공 및 사용자 설정 유지
  • 글·댓글·좋아요 처리, 젬 및 광고 보상 중복 방지
  • 비정상 요청, 자동화, 위변조 앱 및 서비스 남용 방지
  • 광고 제공과 성과 측정

3. 제3자 서비스와 국외 처리

  • Cloudflare: Workers, D1, R2, 캐시, 속도 제한 및 보안 서비스를 사용합니다. 데이터는 Cloudflare의 글로벌 인프라에서 처리될 수 있습니다. Cloudflare Privacy Policy
  • Google AdMob: 광고 제공 과정에서 IP 주소, 광고·앱 상호작용, 진단 정보, 광고 ID 또는 앱 세트 ID 같은 기기 식별자를 자동 처리할 수 있습니다. Google Privacy Policy
  • Google Play Integrity: 앱 진위, 라이선스, 기기 무결성 및 최근 요청 활동을 확인해 남용을 방지합니다.
  • YouTube API Services: 이 앱은 YouTube Data API와 임베디드 YouTube 플레이어를 사용합니다. 공개 영상·채널·플레이리스트 메타데이터를 표시하며, Google/YouTube가 IP 주소, 기기 정보, 쿠키 또는 서비스 이용 정보를 자체 정책에 따라 처리할 수 있습니다. YouTube Terms Google Privacy Policy

개발자는 개인정보를 판매하지 않습니다.

4. 보유기간과 삭제

  • 서버 프로필과 커뮤니티 데이터는 사용자가 계정을 삭제하거나 운영상 삭제할 때까지 보관합니다.
  • 앱 내 계정 삭제 시 D1 프로필, 본인 글·댓글, 좋아요와 첨부 참조를 삭제합니다. 다른 사용자의 답글이 있는 원글은 작성자·본문·첨부를 제거한 익명 자리표시자로 남을 수 있습니다.
  • 광고 보상 transaction ID는 계정 연결을 제거한 뒤 중복 지급과 서명 재사용을 막는 보안 기록으로만 유지합니다.
  • 삭제 전 생성된 공개 응답은 엣지 또는 기기 캐시에 최대 30일 남을 수 있으며, 제공업체 백업은 해당 업체의 제한된 백업 보존기간 후 제거됩니다.
  • 기기 내 즐겨찾기는 서버 계정과 연결되지 않으며 앱 데이터 삭제 또는 앱 제거 시 삭제됩니다.

삭제 방법: 계정 및 데이터 삭제 안내

5. 이용자의 권리

앱에서 프로필을 수정하고 계정과 연결 데이터를 즉시 삭제할 수 있습니다. 앱에 접근할 수 없는 경우 삭제 안내 페이지의 이메일 절차로 열람·정정·삭제를 요청할 수 있습니다.

관련 지역에서 광고 동의가 필요한 경우 앱은 Google의 동의 메시지를 먼저 표시하며, 앱 정보의 광고 개인정보 설정에서 선택을 다시 확인하거나 변경할 수 있습니다. 동의하지 않으면 맞춤형 광고가 제한되거나 광고가 제공되지 않을 수 있습니다.

6. 보안

HTTPS 전송, 접근 제한, 입력 검증, 요청 속도 제한, Play Integrity 검증, 최소한의 운영자 접근을 적용합니다. 어떤 방식도 절대적인 보안을 보장할 수는 없습니다.

7. 아동의 개인정보

이 서비스는 관련 법령상 보호자 동의가 필요한 연령의 아동을 대상으로 설계되지 않았습니다. 보호자 동의 없이 아동 데이터가 제공되었다고 판단되면 아래 연락처로 삭제를 요청해 주세요.

8. 문의 및 방침 변경

개인정보 보호 담당자: Bluemivpublic.bluemiv@gmail.com

처리 방식이 변경되면 이 페이지의 시행일을 갱신하며, 중요한 변경은 앱 또는 이 페이지에서 알립니다.

title: KPOP Tube Apps Privacy Policy
description: Privacy Policy for the KPOP Tube family of apps.
html:
KPOP Tube Apps

Privacy Policy

This policy explains the data handled by the KPOP Tube family of artist-specific Stan apps and your rights.

Effective date: 2026-07-25한국어
No sign-up is required. The app creates a pseudonymous profile using a random device UUID and does not require your name, phone number, or email address.

1. Data we process

  • Pseudonymous profile: random device UUID, optional public ID, nickname, avatar, app group, system language, gem balance, account status, and creation/update timestamps
  • Community activity: post and comment text, references to public photos or YouTube videos, likes, report reasons, a pseudonymous public author identifier, and posting/report timestamps
  • Ad reward records: AdMob transaction ID, pseudonymous user ID, reward amount, and timestamp used to prevent duplicate rewards
  • On-device data: photo/video favorites, language settings, user/API caches, and a security session. This is stored on your device separately from server account data.
  • Service operations: Cloudflare may temporarily process IP addresses and request metadata for security, delivery, rate limiting, and diagnostics.

The app does not collect contacts, precise location, original device photos/videos, or payment card details on its own servers.

2. Why we process data

  • Provide videos, playlists, galleries, community features, and user settings
  • Process posts, comments, likes, gems, and prevent duplicate ad rewards
  • Prevent automated abuse, tampered apps, fraudulent requests, and service disruption
  • Provide advertising and measure ad performance

3. Third parties and international processing

  • Cloudflare: We use Workers, D1, R2, caching, rate limiting, and security services. Data may be processed on Cloudflare’s global infrastructure. Cloudflare Privacy Policy
  • Google AdMob: For advertising, the SDK may automatically process IP address, ad/app interactions, diagnostics, and device identifiers such as advertising ID or app set ID. Google Privacy Policy
  • Google Play Integrity: We verify app recognition, licensing, device integrity, and recent request activity to reduce abuse.
  • YouTube API Services: This app uses the YouTube Data API and embedded YouTube player to display public video, channel, and playlist metadata. Google/YouTube may process IP address, device data, cookies, or service interactions under its own policies. YouTube Terms Google Privacy Policy

The developer does not sell personal data.

4. Retention and deletion

  • Server profile and community data are retained until the user deletes the account or the data is removed for operational reasons.
  • In-app account deletion removes the D1 profile, your posts/comments, likes, and attachment references. A root post with replies from other users may remain as an anonymous placeholder with its author, body, and attachments removed.
  • Ad reward transaction IDs are de-linked from the account and retained only as a security ledger to prevent duplicate rewards and signed callback replay.
  • Previously generated public responses may remain in edge or device caches for up to 30 days. Provider backups are removed after the provider’s limited backup retention period.
  • On-device favorites are not linked to the server account and are removed when app data is cleared or the app is uninstalled.

Deletion instructions: Account and data deletion guide

5. Your rights

You can edit your profile and immediately delete the account and linked data in the app. If you cannot access the app, use the email process on the deletion guide to request access, correction, or deletion.

Where ad consent is required, the app presents Google’s consent message before requesting ads. You can review or change eligible choices from Ad privacy options in App info. Declining may limit personalized ads or prevent ad delivery.

6. Security

We use HTTPS, access controls, input validation, request rate limits, Play Integrity checks, and restricted operator access. No method can guarantee absolute security.

7. Children

The service is not designed for children below the age at which parental consent is required by applicable law. Contact us to request deletion if you believe a child provided data without required consent.

8. Contact and policy changes

Privacy contact: Berryfy / public.bluemiv@gmail.com

If processing changes, we will update the effective date on this page and provide notice in the app or on this page for material changes.

시행일자
2025-09-09
본 개인정보 처리방침은 <‘로또켓645’>(사이트주소: https://bluemiv.github.io/)가 「개인정보 보호법」 제30조에 따라 정보주체의 개인정보를 보호하고 관련 문의를 원활하게 처리하기 위하여 수립·공개하는 것입니다. 로또켓645는 회원가입 없이 이용할 수 있으며, 별도 회원 데이터베이스를 운영하지 않습니다. 일부 광고 기능은 Google AdMob SDK를 통해 제공됩니다.

제1조(처리 목적)

로또켓645는 다음의 목적을 위하여 최소한의 개인정보를 처리합니다. 명시된 목적 외의 용도로는 이용하지 않으며, 목적이 변경되는 경우에는 「개인정보 보호법」 제18조에 따라 별도 동의를 받는 등 필요한 조치를 이행합니다.

  2. 광고 제공: Google AdMob을 통한 맞춤형·표준형 광고 노출, 광고 성과 측정, 부정 클릭 방지 등 광고 운영 목적

제2조(수집 항목 및 수집 방법)

  1. 광고 SDK를 통해 처리될 수 있는 항목: Android 광고 ID(AAID/ADID)
    • 광고 관련 이용 기록: 광고 노출/클릭 등 광고 이벤트 로그(AdMob SDK 수집)
    • 기기·앱 정보: 운영체제 종류/버전, 단말기 모델, 앱 버전 등(AdMob SDK 자동 수집 가능)
    광고 식별자는 단말기별 재설정 가능한 식별자이며, 단말 설정에서 재설정·삭제 또는 맞춤형 광고 제한이 가능합니다.
  2. 앱 안에 저장되는 정보: 생성한 번호, 즐겨찾기, 최근 조회·생성 내역 등은 이용자의 기기 안에 저장됩니다. 로또켓645는 이를 별도 서버로 전송하거나 계정과 연결하지 않습니다.
  3. 카메라 및 QR 스캔: QR 당첨 확인을 위해 카메라 권한을 사용할 수 있습니다. 카메라 화면이나 촬영 이미지는 앱 서버에 저장·전송하지 않으며, QR에 포함된 동행복권 확인 주소를 여는 용도로만 사용합니다.
  4. 로컬 알림: 번호 추천 및 결과 확인 알림은 기기 내 로컬 알림으로 동작하며, 서버 푸시 토큰이나 계정 정보를 수집하지 않습니다.

  2. Google AdMob을 통해 처리되는 광고 관련 정보는 Google LLC의 보관기간 및 정책에 따릅니다.

Potion Sort Quest processes the minimum data necessary for the purposes below. We do not use the data for unrelated purposes unless required by law or with separate notice or consent where applicable.

  1. Providing app features: potion color sorting puzzle play, level progress, hints, undo, coin rewards, background music settings, language settings, and app settings storage
  2. Providing ads: displaying banner, interstitial, and rewarded ads through Google AdMob, measuring ad performance, and preventing invalid activity
  3. Review prompt: managing, on the device, whether a Google Play review prompt has been shown within a user-friendly timing window

2. Data Collected and Collection Method

  1. Data that may be processed through the advertising SDK: Android Advertising ID (AAID/ADID), app set ID, or SDK instance identifiers
    • Ad-related activity: ad impressions, clicks, rewarded ad completion, and similar ad event logs
    • Device and app information: operating system type and version, device model, app version, network status, and other information that the AdMob SDK may process automatically
    The advertising identifier is resettable on the device. Users can reset or delete it and limit personalized ads from Android settings.
  2. Data stored inside the app:current level, coins, hint and undo state, language setting, background music setting, review prompt state, and interstitial ad frequency state are stored locally on the user's device. Potion Sort Quest does not send this local game data to its own server or link it to an account.
  3. Data we do not collect directly: The app does not directly collect names, phone numbers, email addresses, contacts, precise location, photos, camera data, microphone recordings, or payment information.

3. Retention Period

  1. Potion Sort Quest does not store account information or gameplay records on its own server. Local level progress, coins, and settings remain on the device until the user clears app data or deletes the app.
  2. Advertising-related data processed through Google AdMob is retained according to Google LLC's own policies.
  3. If retention is required by applicable law, data may be retained for the period required by that law.

4. Disclosure to Third Parties

Potion Sort Questdoes not sell personal information and does not provide user account information stored on its own server to third parties, because it does not operate such a server. Data independently processed by Google LLC through the advertising SDK is governed by Google LLC's own privacy policies.

5. Service Providers and International Transfer

  1. Potion Sort Quest uses the Google AdMob SDK to provide ads. During this process, advertising data may be transmitted to Google LLC, which may involve international transfer to the United States and other locations where Google operates.
    • Service provider/recipient: Google LLC (AdMob)
    • Country: United States and other locations where Google operates
    • Timing and method: transmitted over the network during app use
    • Data transferred: Android Advertising ID (AAID/ADID), app set ID or SDK instance identifiers, ad event logs, device and app information
    • Purpose: ad delivery, ad operations, analytics, and fraud prevention
    • Retention period: according to Google LLC policies

6. Cookies and Similar Technologies

  1. Cookies: Potion Sort Quest is a mobile app and does not directly use website cookies.
  2. Android Advertising ID (AAID/ADID): This may be used for advertising.
    • Android: Settings > Privacy > Ads > Reset/Delete Advertising ID or limit personalized ads
    • Changing these settings may limit personalized ads or reset/delete the advertising identifier.

7. Data Deletion

  1. The app does not store account information on its own server.
  2. Local data is deleted when the user clears app data or deletes the app.
  3. If we separately retain electronic files in the future, they will be deleted using a method designed to prevent recovery or restoration.

8. Security Measures

Potion Sort Quest applies the following measures to protect user data.

  • Data minimization, no account server, review of third-party SDK settings, minimum app permissions, local storage for game state, controlled development access, and security update checks

9. User Rights

  • Users may request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing where applicable. Since Potion Sort Quest does not keep account data on its own server, local app data can be deleted directly by clearing app data or uninstalling the app.

Blim Account Deletion Guide

1. Delete Your Account in the App

You can delete your account directly in the Blim app using the path below.

  1. Select the "Profile" tab in the bottom navigation.
  2. Open "Privacy & Security".
  3. Tap "Delete Account".
  4. Review the notice and confirm by tapping "Delete Account".

2. Request Deletion by Email

If you cannot access the app or log in, you can request account deletion by email.

Email: public.bluemiv@gmail.com

Subject: [Blim] Account Deletion Request

Required Info: Sign-in method (Google/Guest) and account identifier (email or user ID)

Requests are processed within 3 business days.

3. Data That Will Be Deleted

When deletion is completed, the following data will be removed.

  • Account data (login identifier, email, profile display information)
  • Chat messages, conversation summaries, and chat session data
  • Character progress data (likes, unlocked cards, and related progress)
  • Gem balance and wallet/purchase/subscription-related service data
  • Support feedback and report history

4. Retention and Final Deletion

  • After a deletion request, the account is deactivated immediately and may be kept for up to 30 days for recovery.
  • If you log in again within 30 days, the account may be restored.
  • After 30 days, account and service data are deleted.
  • Certain records such as payment records may be retained as required by applicable law, then deleted.

5. Contact

For account deletion questions, contact us at public.bluemiv@gmail.com.

The App does not provide personal information to third parties in principle. However, it may be provided if required by law or with separate consent from the data subject.

Privacy Policy

Effective date: 03-05-2025

This Privacy Policy is established and disclosed by <‘KPOP Clip’> (URL: https://bluemiv.github.io/) in accordance with Article 30 of the Personal Information Protection Act to protect the personal information of data subjects and to handle related complaints promptly and smoothly.

Article 1 (Purpose of Processing)

KPOP Clip processes only the minimum personal information for the purposes below. It is not used for any other purposes, and if the purpose changes, KPOP Clip will take necessary measures such as obtaining separate consent under Article 18 of the Personal Information Protection Act.

  1. Content delivery: Provide features to watch YouTube videos of specific artists and to download photos that are publicly available on the internet within the app.
  2. Advertising, analytics, and service quality improvement: Personalized ad delivery, fraud prevention, app usage analytics (GA4), and service quality improvement.

Article 2 (Items Collected and Collection Methods)

  1. Collected items (required) – Mobile advertising identifier: Android Advertising ID (AAID/ADID) or iOS IDFA
    • Ad/analytics usage records: Ad impressions/clicks, screen views, button taps, and other event logs.
    • Device and app information: OS type/version, device model, app version, etc. (may be automatically collected by analytics SDKs).
    The advertising identifier is a device-specific resettable identifier. Users can reset/delete it or limit personalized advertising in their device settings.
  2. Collection methods
    • Collected automatically via mobile SDKs (e.g., Google AdMob, GA4) when the app is installed and used, without any sign-up or login process.

Article 3 (Retention and Use Period)

  1. KPOP Clip does not operate separate servers to store users’ identifying information for long periods. Data used for advertising and analytics follows the retention settings and policies of the respective SDK providers.
  2. GA4 retention: The administrator can select 2 months or 14 months. Google Signals data may be retained for up to 26 months regardless of this setting.
  3. When the purpose is achieved or the retention period expires, the data will be promptly destroyed, or if required by law, stored separately.

Article 4 (Provision to Third Parties)

KPOP Clip does not provide personal information to third parties by default. However, it may be provided when there is a legal basis or with separate consent from the data subject.

Article 5 (Outsourcing and Cross-Border Transfers)

  1. For stable service provision, KPOP Clip may outsource parts of personal information processing to external processors. If a processor is located overseas, cross-border transfers may occur. KPOP Clip complies with applicable laws when concluding outsourcing agreements.
    • Processor / Recipient: Google LLC (AdMob, Google Analytics)
    • Destination country: United States
    • Timing and method of transfer: Real-time transmission over the network whenever the app is used.
    • Items transferred: Advertising identifiers (AAID/IDFA), usage records (ad impressions/clicks, event logs, etc.), device/app information (OS, device model, app version, etc.).
    • Purpose of use: Ad delivery, statistical analysis, and service quality improvement.
    • Retention period: As set out in Article 3 and in each processor’s policy.
    Note: On Android, users can reset/delete the advertising ID and limit personalized ads in Settings.

Article 6 (Automated Collection Tools: Use and Opt-out)

  1. Cookies: Given the nature of mobile apps, KPOP Clip does not use cookies.
  2. Advertising Identifier (AAID/IDFA): Used for ad delivery and analytics.
    • Android: Settings > Privacy > Ads > Reset/Delete Advertising ID, and limit personalized ads.
    • (On iOS, you can manage tracking permissions in Settings.) Changing these settings may limit personalized ads or reset/delete the related identifier.

Article 7 (Destruction Procedures and Methods)

  1. Data will be destroyed without delay when the reason for destruction arises.
  2. Electronic files: Permanently deleted using irreversible technical methods.
  3. Printed materials: Shredded or incinerated.

Article 8 (Security Measures)

To comply with the “Standards for Ensuring the Security of Personal Information,” KPOP Clipimplements measures such as:
  • Establishing and implementing an internal management plan, access control, keeping and protecting access logs against alteration, encryption (where applicable), anti-malware and security programs, and periodic inspections and training.

Article 9 (Rights of Data Subjects and How to Exercise Them)

  • Data subjects may at any time exercise the rights to request access, correction, deletion, and suspension of processing. These rights may also be exercised through a representative (with a power of attorney in the prescribed form).
  • Requests may be submitted in writing, by email, or by fax. KPOP Clip will handle them without undue delay.
  • Where there are statutory grounds to restrict access or refuse suspension, KPOP Clip will act in accordance with the relevant laws.

Article 10 (Data Protection Officer & Access Request Contact)

  • Data Protection Officer: Bluemiv
  • Contact: public.bluemiv@gmail.com
  • Access request contact: Same as above.

Article 11 (Remedies)

  • For counseling or dispute resolution regarding personal information infringements, you may contact the organizations below.
  • Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972, www.kopico.go.kr
  • Personal Information Infringement Report Center (KISA): 118, privacy.kisa.or.kr
  • Supreme Prosecutors’ Office: 1301, www.spo.go.kr
  • Korean National Police Agency (Cyber Bureau): 182, ecrm.cyber.go.kr

Article 12 (Integration with External Services)

The app provides content through YouTube links/players. Where YouTube or other platforms collect and process personal information, their own privacy policies apply. Please refer to each provider’s policy for details.

Article 13 (Changes to this Privacy Policy)

This policy applies from 03-05-2025. If there are changes due to laws, service content, or processors, KPOP Clip will notify users of the changes and effective date on the website.

The App does not provide personal information to third parties in principle. However, it may be provided if required by law or with separate consent from the data subject.
